profile.headline: Software Engineer III at American Express
profile.summary: My first encounter with programming was the moment that changed my life forever. I decided to create a space invaders style game using C# in the unity engine just as a fun way to pass the time, but quickly found myself hooked. I have always had a love for experiencing and learning new things and I enjoyed the new challenges along with the knowledge gained from conquering them. Soon after completing my first project, I learned of Software Development as being a career path that could provide the same stimulation and challenge daily. Since then I have embarked on a journey to grow as both a developer and a person and have loved every minute of it.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain UI for the company's internal web portal used to support business initiatives
• Consume REST APIs to expose backend data to the UI
• Implemented UI bookmarklet tool, which allows users to trigger Zelle payment refunds
• Framework(s)/Language(s) used: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, HTML
• Unit test React components via jest and react testing library, achieving 100% line coverage
• Operating in an agile scrum environment
• Proficient with git commands and CI/CD practices via GitHub for version control

positions.title: Software Engineer III Intern
positions.description:
•	Implemented system of record backend used to call incident creation API
•	Developing UI for incident creation via API calls
•	Framework(s)/Language(s) used: React, Java, JavaScript, CSS
•	Unit test Java classes using JUnit, achieving over 90%-line coverage
•	Unit test React components via jest and enzyme, achieving over 90%-line coverage
•	Operating in an agile scrum environment

positions.title: Java Web Development Project
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented front-end and back-end of the web application.
•	Language(s) used: Java, HTML, CSS, SQL. 
•	Implemented account creation, user posts, and commenting on posts.
•	Implemented administrator login, allowing account update and deletion.
•	User Interface implemented using Java Server Pages (JSP).
•	Implemented a model view controller (MVC) architecture.
•	Established a MySQL database with referential integrity to serve the web application.
•	Implemented Java Servlets to handle HTTP requests and responses.
•	Implemented email sending via google remote SMTP server.
•	https://github.com/karyJ101/PosterBomb.git

positions.title: Php Web Development Project
positions.description:
•	Designed and Implemented the font-end and back-end of the web application
•	Language(s) used: PHP, SQL, HTML, and CSS. 
•	Integrated sign-in, sign-up, landing, sell, and account pages.
•	Allow users to post multiple vehicles for sale with up to 3 pictures per post.
•	Implemented form validation and password hashing for security.
•	Successfully integrated filtering feature to filter vehicles by make or model.
•	Utilized a MySQL database with referential integrity to serve the website.

positions.title: Shape Shooter
positions.description:
•	Created, developed, and deployed 2-D space shape shooter.
•	Language(s) used: C# via the Unity Engine.
•	Collaborated with graphic designer to develop UI design.
•	Implemented health pickups, and blaster powerup to increase fire rate 3 times normal rate.
•	Randomly switched target shape to increase difficulty.
•	Successfully implemented enemy speed increase feature to increase speed of shapes by 50% every 10 seconds.

positions.title: Astro Attack
positions.description:
•	Created, developed, and deployed challenging, fast-paced Sci-fi top-down 2-D shooter.
•	Language(s) used: C# via the Unity Engine.
•	Included features such as health pick-ups, and weapon swaps. 
•	Implemented enemy and boss logic to track and attack player.
•	Setup spawn points to randomly generate enemies.

positions.title: Php Web Development Project
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented font-end and back-end of the web application.
•	Language(s) used: PHP, SQL, HTML, and CSS.
•	Allowed account creation, deletion, and user postings.

positions.title: Android Application Development Internship
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented company mobile application user interface.
•	Language(s) used: Java via Android Studio. 
•	Integrated geolocation for GPS tracking features.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Information Systems Technology concentrated in Application Development
